purpose: Tracked page outputs deterministically preserve the source content file's permission bits: an executable script output (e.g. a tracked .sh, or an HTML file made executable) must stay executable, and an ordinary content output must keep its source mode. Previously every generated output was written read-only (0444), so a tracked executable lost its execute bit on every build.
trigger: Warden's website root 'install' executable resets to non-executable surfaced the fact that nift rebuilds rewrite outputs 0444, stripping the execute bit from tracked executable outputs.
fix: filesystem::file_permissions(path) reads the source content file's mode (fs::status().permissions()); write_readonly_file/write_readonly_files take an explicit fs::perms mode (default read-only 0444, so .nift/public/*.info.json build metadata stays read-only); ProjectInfo's page-write path passes content_path(info)'s permissions, falling back to 0444 when the source mode cannot be read.
guard: tests/output_permissions_smoke.sh (make test-output-permissions), wired into the bh2-test-integrity CI-equivalent chain.

green_runs.outcome: GREEN: output mode 755; './public/script.sh' executes and prints 'run'
GREEN: output mode 644 (source-preserving, no longer forced 0444)
